subject.title: fix: tighten findSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer with execution guard

question: Should session file-search calls that currently provide a fractional `limit` continue to normalize, or should OpenClaw reject them as invalid integer-only tool input?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically small, but it deliberately changes a currently accepted model-tool input contract; repository evidence does not establish which behavior maintainers want across the related tool surfaces.

options.title: Accept integer-only validation
options.body: Approve fractional `limit` rejection for the find tool and retain the proposed schema plus direct-execution guard.

options.title: Preserve normalization
options.body: Keep accepting fractional direct calls and normalize them as current main does, optionally tracking a broader tool-schema policy separately.

options.title: Set a cross-tool policy first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether find, grep, read, and process limits should share one compatibility rule.

recommendation.title: Accept integer-only validation
recommendation.body: Approve fractional `limit` rejection for the find tool and retain the proposed schema plus direct-execution guard.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the latest focused revisions to the proposed contract tests, though current-main ownership evidence is limited.
